name: Budding Blossom Rod

Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Druidcraft at will, Overgrowth once a day, and it mends plants.
text: While holding this rod you can cast Druidcraft at will and, once per dawn, Plant Growth (its Overgrowth only). As a Magic action you can restore the ordinary plants in a 5-foot cube you can see within 15 feet to full health for 1d4 days.

powers.name: Overgrowth
powers.text: Once a day: Plant Growth's Overgrowth.

params.text: brings the ordinary plants in a 5-foot cube back to health for a few days
